title: 2021-04-13 Requirements for API specification - DEXF
content:
Date:

Attendees:

Background

During penetration testing of nKP one finding was that DEXF specification is accessible publicly on SwaggerHub.

Question sent to Tayseer El tarifi and Per Larsson regarding availability of Inter IKEA internal SwaggerHub or other tool for sharing API specifications securely.

Meeting with Tayseer El tarifi and Stefanos Stantzos and regarding how to share API documentation and what tooling is available. Currently no common tooling available but we should revert with requirements from IPEX perspective.

Notes

Notes also sent to attendants of meeting mentioned in background

Below functionality is requested:

  • Visualize API in a user-friendly way

  • Facilitate Your API Lifecycle
    Central repository for hosting and accessing API definitions
    API versioning for ongoing maintenance and continuous iteration

  • Hosted, Interactive API Documentation
    Auto-generate Swagger UI documentation
    Import and Host API Documentation
    host API documentation in the cloud, and securely provide access

  • Contract specification during development - today Open API specification and Mock data used in test cases

  • API Client - structured executable examples that conceptually document API

Today SwaggerHub and Postman is used for use cases below
